question_pt: Em qual mês de cada ano (2008-2023) ocorreu o maior número de internações em UTI?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ano, mes, total_uti FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") AS mes, COUNT(*) AS total_uti, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY ano, mes) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ano;
